episode_summary: Julia Hurley shares her journey from being voted out of a company to building a successful real estate business and athlete management firm. She offers actionable strategies for lead generation, including hosting open houses and using free tools like Google Docs for tracking. Julia emphasizes the importance of providing value to top producers and re-engaging past clients to overcome business challenges.
